referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The official TAR Roofing Chicago residential contractor homepage was inspected in paired desktop and mobile full-page captures. The page opens with a pale skyline image behind a left roof-service statement and a dark navy quote form on the right. It uses two-tier white and dark-blue navigation with phone and service tabs. The visual system relies on rounded, firm sans headings and short supporting paragraphs; surfaces include white, light gray, deep navy and accents include bright blue, pale blue. Imagery is large circular roof and house crops, a service house photograph, and a gallery mosaic. The page then runs through skyline and quote hero, circular roof introduction, residential service image and tabs, curved blue process band, trust and company chapter, step-by-step process, project gallery, contact footer. Its service presentation is tabbed residential, condo, siding, and gutter choices next to a large property image. Mobile changes to move form and phone into an early compact flow, stack circular images with text, and turn service tabs into touch-safe rows. Transfer only the layout rhythm and decision path. Do not copy TAR identity, photographs, quote promises, rating, professional claims, project images, or exact curved graphic motifs.
